title: Run Issue requests reliably with clear pause and retry states
description: Implement `aftergrid intake` as the v0 runner for an Operator's Instance; internal aftergrid development still uses beads. Poll labelled GitHub Issues, snapshot the request, establish a stable run identity, invoke the headless harness with the configured hook/limits, and create or update one linked Finding PR. Treat issue content and source values as task data, not permission to alter controls. Missing definitions, external sign-off or clarification pauses as needs-input; technical failure reports a recoverable reason. Retry/resume must neither duplicate PRs nor lose completed artifacts, and concurrent duplicate triggers claim the same run safely. Human approval remains required for publication. A GitHub Actions recipe is optional; it must not be necessary for the local poller to work.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Workflow boundary test drives labelled Issue to linked draft PR with real fixture artifacts using controlled GitHub/harness interfaces.
- [ ] Runner verifies active hook, source limits and allowed Instance scope before executing; absent enforcement prevents dispatch.
- [ ] Missing input/approval yields a visible needs-input state; providing it resumes the existing run instead of starting a duplicate.
- [ ] Duplicate and concurrent triggers, interruption after PR creation, API rate-limit/transient failure and restart reuse the run/PR identity safely.
- [ ] Issue edits after dispatch are detected as a new input revision or require explicit resume; partial work cannot be mislabeled complete.
- [ ] Messages/logs contain ids and actionable status without private query results or credentials; publication never occurs on agent review alone.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Verify the complete installable v0 package without publishing it
description: Assemble the npm CLI package, Claude Code plugin with explicit promoted skills, skills.sh layout, openai.yaml files and docs per skill. Include new finding, check, render, decide and intake; synchronize help, invocation policies and dependency installation instructions. Test a locally packed package from a clean disposable environment on the declared supported platforms, including native-runtime binary availability without requiring local compilation. The full install must scaffold an Instance, install the hook, produce a draft Finding and exercise intake pause/resume using synthetic services. Preserve MIT notices where adapted. Creating/testing package artifacts is separate from publishing npm, changing repository visibility or activating a public release.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Plugin validation and clean-install smoke pass; all promoted skills/docs/openai.yaml invocation policies agree.
- [ ] Locally packed CLI runs new finding, check, draft render, decide and intake fixture workflow from a clean supported environment.
- [ ] Setup installs and exercises the hook; missing external dependencies/capabilities produce accurate recovery guidance.
- [ ] Package and documentation contain only synthetic/public material and secret references; license notices are retained.
- [ ] Public publish/repository visibility actions are absent from this task; candidate artifacts and installation instructions are ready for owner review.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Run and check one retained DuckDB analysis
description: Implement the adapter contract against immutable DuckDB inputs: typed execute, capture, open-retained, capability-aware privilege probe, non-executing estimate or explicit unknown, resource limits, statement guard and catalog read. Start the capability matrix here; SQL types do not infer business units, and DuckDB does not have Postgres-style roles. Use read-only local database access and explicitly documented runtime limits as its applicable safeguards. One real reconciliation compares analysis output with canonical definition SQL. Validate retained-input hashes and deterministic result serialization including decimal, null, timestamp/timezone and row-order handling. Reject writes to source data without blocking controlled workspace artifact creation. Never silently substitute a live input for missing retained data.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] check executes exemplar queries and reconciliation Checks on retained inputs; wrong answer and input-hash mismatch fail for their intended categories.
- [ ] Shared seam-2 tests cover execute/types, capture, open-retained, catalog, write/DDL denial, cancellation/limits, estimate-under-cap and documented unknown-estimate behavior.
- [ ] A LIMIT query with an over-cap estimate is rejected; LIMIT alone never passes admission, and runtime limits remain active after estimate approval.
- [ ] Mutating the source after capture leaves the retained rerun unchanged; missing/corrupt retained inputs produce an explicit unavailable/error result.
- [ ] Capability matrix records unsupported role probe and business units as declared metadata or unknown; it never advertises a skipped capability as supported.
- [ ] A recorded supported-platform install succeeds without local compilation; failed query/cancellation cleans up resources and leaves source inputs unchanged.
- [ ] Artifact-verification mode validates saved references/hashes without executing SQL; rerun mode actually executes the recorded Checks and reports their current results.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Enforce evidence integrity with meaningful failure fixtures
description: Complete evidence validation at the Finding seam: exact decimal handling, null/not-available/zero distinction, display-only rounding, declared derivation operations and units, zero-denominator behavior, cycle rejection, stable row keys, typed external sources, and data-bearing prose references. Validate Claim/Recheck/Question/Decision shapes using the canonical schema. Separate kind metric|diagnostic from lifecycle proposed|approved|deprecated. Published decision metrics require a pinned approved definition; traced diagnostics can appear as supporting evidence with their status, while provisional-source results remain unshareable. Date/section/label exceptions do not excuse unreferenced analytical values. Semantic implications such as causality remain review work, not a claim of perfect numeric lint. Decision recording has a separate command bead, not an unrelated append operation hidden here.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Each seam-1 negative fails for its intended reason rather than an unrelated missing-review failure; valid and inconclusive controls continue passing evidence validity.
- [ ] Precision/rounding/null/derived-unit/zero-denominator/cycle cases validate consistently across evidence references.
- [ ] Typed targets/assumptions resolve with source type; dates and section labels do not create false failures, while hand-copied analytical values fail.
- [ ] Duplicate keys, missing columns, wrong references, unsupported schema versions and absent definition versions fail with actionable locations.
- [ ] Proposed decision metrics are not publication-ready; diagnostics retain explicit status, and no provisional data enters Reader export.
- [ ] Synthetic semantic failure scenarios are routed to expected abstention or method review when a mechanical invariant cannot establish correctness.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Validate external release readiness after the internal v0 milestone
description: Follow-on gate, not a child feature required to finish internal v0. Run the agreed formative study with roughly five non-data participants and two to three practitioners: correct, inconclusive and controlled-misleading Findings with debriefing; inspect denominator/baseline/limitations, decide and follow up. Observe an outside Operator onboarding bounded data and correcting a definition. Look for a second voluntary use on a real decision and record friction, errors and unresolved issues. This is qualitative evidence, not a statistical success-rate claim. Prepare source/package release artifacts and a concrete owner review of what becomes public; activation itself requires the owner's explicit release instruction. Public engine source publication and product readiness must not be conflated.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Study actually completed and debriefed, not merely scheduled; private records include misunderstandings, limitations and resulting corrections.
- [ ] Outside Operator completes setup, a definition correction and regeneration; a second voluntary use is observed or its absence is explicitly reported.
- [ ] Release-blocking findings are resolved or sent to the owner for a documented release decision; no participant-count threshold is portrayed as statistical proof.
- [ ] Public artifact inventory excludes private Instance data and unvalidated coverage claims; package/source publication is a separate explicit owner action.
- [ ] The decision to release or defer, its rationale and remaining risks are recorded without automatically changing repository visibility or publishing packages.

title: Review Finding exemplars with a non-data reader before implementation
description: First user-value gate; no production implementation. Define the versioned manifest JSON Schema, restricted reference grammar, Instance layout, named Reader-profile format and generic fallback. Hand-author two complete, synthetic exemplar directories: a numeric retention comparison with two Claims, one chart and one table; and an insufficient-data Finding that explains the missing evidence without inventing an answer. Create the static HTML reference the renderer will match. Include Answer, decision context, visible conclusion-changing caveat, population/baseline/window, expandable calculation and exclusions, source freshness, distinct trust facts and owner follow-up. Use authentic human Reader feedback to revise the contract before coding; a Reader subagent cannot complete this gate. Every required field and conditional branch has a documented example or dedicated small companion case; do not force incompatible schema branches into one Finding.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] JSON Schema, reference grammar, Instance layout and Reader-profile format are reviewed documents; draft/complete Finding states and evidence-valid/publication-ready outcomes are distinct.
- [ ] Both complete exemplar directories contain mutually consistent memo, manifest, SQL, saved results, Checks and evidence references; no fabricated approvals or private company data.
- [ ] One non-data person explains the answer, denominator, baseline and limitation, chooses an action or deliberate inaction, and asks a follow-up; observations and resulting contract changes are recorded.
- [ ] Numeric and insufficient-data experiences are both reviewed; mobile reading, keyboard expansion, meaningful chart descriptions and accessible data tables are specified in the HTML reference.
- [ ] Missing input, not-automatically-evaluable policies, derived values and typed external assumptions have explicit examples; unresolved questions identify an owner rather than fake placeholder answers.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Compare the automated private readout with the manual Finding
description: Run the approved chain on the private Spot Sports Instance: setup, Postgres retained capture, clarification/analysis, review, checked render and a real owner Decision record through aftergrid decide. Compare automated output with the earlier hand-authored Finding on equivalent populations/windows/input versions. Explain legitimate differences from new data or corrected definitions rather than forcing a stale answer match. Record Operator effort, failures/recovery, Reader understanding and follow-up handling. Use genuine human approval for a published artifact; do not synthesize GitHub reviews. Full data and recorded interactions stay in spot_sports/analytics; only sanitized completion evidence and contract lessons belong in aftergrid.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Private Finding passes evidence validity and genuine publication readiness and renders; the approval round trip and source identities are documented privately.
- [ ] Comparison to the manual Finding controls for input/window/definition differences; any discrepancy has a reviewed explanation.
- [ ] A Reader can inspect the comparison and ask a follow-up; owner records an actual action or deliberate inaction, not an agent-inferred decision.
- [ ] aftergrid decide records the exact Finding/Claim revisions; merging alone creates no decision.
- [ ] Operator setup/review time and observed friction are recorded as evidence for improvement without imposing invented performance targets.
- [ ] Public-engine fixtures/logs contain no private source schema, identifiers, data or personal study transcripts.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Clarify questions and produce checked Analysis inputs
description: Implement /grill-question as the user entry for clarifying a raw ask and /checked-analysis as the reusable analysis procedure. Factor clarification into an internal/model-invoked procedure that /analyze can reuse without invoking another user-invoked skill. Ask only information that changes the analysis; show reasonable assumptions for correction and preserve answers already provided. Identify the decision, Reader, primary population/comparison/window and falsifier or explicit unresolved condition before final analysis cuts. Probe available data before committing an impossible plan. Propose definitions without mutating approved versions. Write applicable invariants/reconciliation Checks before final analysis SQL, record exploratory versus pre-registered comparisons, run on retained inputs and emit the exact Analysis-directory contract consumed by the writer. A raw ask with missing data can end in a needs-input or needs-reframing result, never a fabricated executable falsifier.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Raw ask and already-clarified Question paths both work; repeated clarification does not ask settled questions again.
- [ ] Question/Analysis artifacts validate and identify assumptions, Reader and primary comparison; missing approvals/input produce a specific needs-input state.
- [ ] Recorded execution order shows applicable Checks prepared before final analysis SQL, with probing/exploratory cuts labeled separately.
- [ ] Definitions are proposed/versioned without auto-approval; diagnostics have explicit status and cannot silently become a headline metric.
- [ ] The resulting Analysis directory is consumed unchanged by the writer; synthetic acceptance run includes insufficient-data or reframing outcome.
- [ ] Skill invocation graph has no user-invoked-to-user-invoked calls; both /grill-question and /analyze reuse the internal clarification procedure.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Enforce supported query paths and provisional-source boundaries
description: Provide the Claude Code PreToolUse integration for the tested adapter policy, before unattended execution. Distinguish source-database writes/DDL and budget violations from allowed local Finding file creation and controlled disposable-database provisioning. Test explicitly supported alternative query entry points (psql, DuckDB CLI, node invocation), documenting harness limitations rather than claiming a universal shell sandbox. Source permissions and runtime isolation remain the boundary if a hook cannot inspect a path. Provisional reads of non-sensitive unverified sources require a scoped human sign-off record (source, reason, approver evidence, date, expiry), referenced by the run; an editable approver name alone is insufficient. Mark all derived results provisional and exclude them transitively from Reader publication. Hard privacy, database permission and execution limits have no override.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Write/DDL/over-budget attempts through supported paths fail with clear reasons while ordinary local artifact creation still works.
- [ ] Alternate-path tests demonstrate hook enforcement and underlying source/adapter limits; unsupported paths fail closed or are explicitly unavailable.
- [ ] Missing, expired, wrong-source or unverified sign-off blocks provisional reads; valid scoped sign-off is logged.
- [ ] Provisional-source status propagates through derived values and prevents publishing them even if references and numerical Checks pass.
- [ ] Hook install/uninstall is idempotent and preserves other harness configuration; setup can test whether the intended hook is active.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Revise and choose charts without silently changing meaning
description: Implement /iterate-visual and /revise-finding on the working renderer and publication contract. Render, inspect PNG, evaluate the documented visual rubric and revise at most three passes; stop early when satisfactory and return a still-failing result to the Operator. Variants share pinned evidence and analytical semantics, and the Operator chooses a concrete preview when present. Background runs use the same bounded default path without waiting forever for a taste choice. Presentation edits re-render and re-check; numeric/query changes reopen analysis, and possible interpretation changes conservatively require applicable review. Do not claim perfect automated semantic change detection. Keep revision history and preserve the previously reviewed artifact; use aftergrid decide for decision records.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Recorded runs cover early success and three-pass failure with a clear reason/next step, without a fake success score.
- [ ] Operator selects a visible Variant; selected chart preserves evidence bindings and discarded variants do not appear in the publication.
- [ ] Number/query changes reopen analysis; tested causal-wording/hidden-comparison/axis changes invalidate applicable review.
- [ ] Cosmetic change creates a new render/revision with truthful readiness; previous approved artifacts remain reconstructable.
- [ ] Background path completes or returns needs-attention without waiting for a nonexistent Operator; visual score never substitutes for evidence or method gates.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Test a hand-authored real Finding before writing skills
description: Before automated skill authoring, create a bounded private DuckDB extract and hand-author the Spot Sports podcast/video Finding under the tested contract. Record extraction provenance, coverage, metric meanings, exclusions and limitations; do not claim an unrecorded extraction method is a durable live-source snapshot. Run evidence checks and Reader-safe draft rendering, then observe one real non-data Reader explaining and using it. This is the learning gate for writer and analytical skills, not a requirement to fabricate a favorable product finding. Public-engine work receives only sanitized contract lessons and issue references; data, personal feedback, transcripts and complete Finding stay in spot_sports/analytics. A draft may be used for this supervised study with its missing approval clearly shown.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Private extract, definitions and hand-authored Finding pass evidence validity; numerical results are manually reconciled and draft/publication status is truthful.
- [ ] A non-data Reader explains answer, denominator, baseline and limitation, proposes action or deliberate inaction and a useful follow-up; both misunderstanding and correct understanding are recorded.
- [ ] At least one contrasting or inconclusive scenario tests whether the Reader understands the comparison rather than repeats the headline.
- [ ] Contract gaps are resolved or explicitly triaged before skill tasks start; private feedback informs the Reader profile without entering public fixtures.
- [ ] The pilot does not require complete product setup, Postgres automation or a fabricated GitHub approval; its source capture and privacy limits are documented.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Run versioned nightly evaluations and make regressions actionable
description: Schedule the model-in-the-loop /analyze suite on the deterministic synthetic reference Questions. Store per-case answer/abstention, permitted evidence, definition versions, assertion outcomes, skill/git/model versions and bounded run cost/time. Distinguish infrastructure/API failures from analytical regressions. Summaries point to reproducible artifacts and the failing contract; they do not expose production data or flood the repo with identical reports. Nightly results are not a PR merge gate; the internal v0 milestone explicitly requires a passing evaluation at its exact candidate revision. Deterministic schema/adapter/render suites still run on PRs.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] At least one complete scheduled run passes on pinned synthetic inputs; results record all relevant versions and case outcomes.
- [ ] Expected-abstention regression fails its case, while runner/API failures are reported as infrastructure errors rather than wrong answers.
- [ ] Injected failure produces one actionable summary linked to the retained run artifacts; repeated identical failures do not create duplicate issues.
- [ ] Run timeout/budget is bounded and partial completion is explicit; no metric/approval behavior is mocked into apparent success.
- [ ] A manual invocation can evaluate an exact release candidate SHA without waiting for the nightly schedule.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Capture and rerun bounded Postgres analysis with honest capabilities
description: Implement capture in one read-only REPEATABLE READ transaction and store bounded extracts plus schema/runtime requirements and content hashes. open-retained restores into a disposable compatible Postgres under controlled provisioning, then runs original analysis SQL with a read-only analysis role; it never falls back to live data. Use EXPLAIN without ANALYZE for non-executing planner estimates, explicit unknown and documented fallback, cancellation and statement timeout. work_mem is per-operation tuning, not a total memory ceiling; advertise hard memory limits only where the hosting/runtime actually enforces them. Probe effective source privileges and required runtime features, preserve relevant types/timezones, and document unsupported extensions/functions. Record evidence-backed capabilities for Postgres; PostHog managed warehouse remains unvalidated until separately proven. If no compatible runtime exists, historical SQL rerun is unavailable while saved-result artifact replay remains possible.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Full shared seam-2 suite passes for DuckDB and Postgres, with unsupported capabilities explicitly reported rather than skipped as green.
- [ ] Concurrent-source capture and mutate-after-capture cases reproduce the original retained-input answer independently of live data.
- [ ] Over-cap LIMIT query fails; unknown estimates follow the documented safe policy and cancellation cleans up transactions/temporary resources.
- [ ] Unavailable runtime, unsupported extension/type and corrupt extract produce actionable unavailable/error states; saved-result replay does not require starting Postgres.
- [ ] Capability matrix distinguishes planner units, timeout, per-operation memory tuning and actual runtime memory isolation; no false monetary or total-memory guarantee.
- [ ] Source permissions block writes, including applicable indirect write paths; restore is scoped to the disposable destination and cannot modify the source.
- [ ] With the Postgres runtime unavailable, artifact verification/draft replay succeeds from intact saved results while SQL rerun reports unavailable, never freshly passed.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Bind publication to verified human approval and exact evidence
description: Implement the publication boundary separately from evidence validity. Hash canonical semantic manifest fields, referenced definition/input identities, memo/query/Check/chart-spec/result contents and pinned house-style/renderer versions; exclude self-hash, attestations, generated outputs and volatile execution timestamps. Verify metric approval against its own immutable content and Finding approval against the referenced Finding digest. v0 authority is a current, non-dismissed GitHub APPROVED review at the exact analyzed PR commit by an allowlisted human, read independently through the API. The approver allowlist is trusted Instance policy, not a mutable field in the analyzed PR. Cover the solo setup: a distinct automation identity authors the PR, the human reviews it, and the runner cannot use reviewer credentials. Unknown/unreachable verification permits only a truthful draft. Analysis/evidence check results are produced by the trusted validator; an agent may not self-assert human approval. Regenerate derived outputs from checked source for publication; never trust adjacent cached HTML/SVG.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Stale digest, forged metadata, wrong SHA, unauthorized login, dismissed/replaced review and untrusted allowlist changes fail readiness; API failure reports unknown, not approved.
- [ ] A sandbox-repository smoke demonstrates distinct PR author and human approver identities; same-account author/self-approval impossibility is surfaced during setup without a bypass.
- [ ] Finding type/caveat/exclusion/export-policy changes invalidate its review; unchanged definition approval survives a cosmetic Finding revision.
- [ ] check reports evidence validity and publication readiness separately and never mutates the hashed inputs; a draft remains available without human approval.
- [ ] Tampered generated HTML/SVG is discarded and regenerated; publication uses one consistent validated source view and private sentinels never leak.
- [ ] Tests use controlled API doubles for reproducibility plus the documented human approval round trip; the agent is never asked to impersonate a human reviewer.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Render an inspectable, accessible Finding for the Reader
description: Render the reviewed exemplar experience from validated source: constrained Vega-Lite specs, SVG charts, PNG previews through a WASM rasterizer, and one self-contained HTML artifact. Validate nested/layered specs and encodings against the allowlist, bind chart data only to saved evidence, and apply a pinned house style. Reader sees the Answer and its material caveat together, population/baseline/window, expandable calculation/exclusions, distinct evidence/review facts, coverage/generated-at and a canonical location. Numeric Claims have a chart or table; nonnumeric outcomes explain what evidence is missing. One mailto action carries Finding and optional selected Claim ids, never data values; show a copyable owner contact and ids when no mail client is configured. Reader-safe export applies to visible content, hidden payloads and metadata. Draft rendering must not claim human approval.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Both exemplars render to the reviewed layout and factual values, including an insufficient-data Finding with no numerical chart; forbidden nested transforms/encodings or arbitrary data sources fail.
- [ ] All referenced values agree across prose, tables, chart labels and annotations, with consistent units and display-only rounding.
- [ ] Private sentinels are absent from HTML, SVG, embedded data and metadata; unsafe embedded markup/links cannot bypass the export or rendering policy.
- [ ] At a phone-sized viewport the Answer/caveat and key comparison remain readable; evidence expansion works by keyboard, charts have descriptions and data tables have semantic headers.
- [ ] Follow-up action includes only ids; visible fallback contact works without GitHub, and generation/coverage copy does not imply a downloaded file discovers future supersession.
- [ ] Draft is visibly labeled with truthful missing-review status; SVG/PNG are regenerated from source using pinned renderer/style versions, with no native compile step for chart rasterization.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Orchestrate a raw question to a reviewed draft with a golden eval
description: Implement /analysis-review and /analyze across the established contracts. /analyze accepts raw ask or clarified Question; reuse the internal clarification procedure, then checked-analysis, writing/narrative/visual craft, Method/Question/Reader review, and check. Only one orchestrator owns ordering; craft steps are not repeated by nested orchestrators. Reviewer subagents return blocking concerns and notes, use the named Reader profile and distinguish insufficient evidence from broken execution. Halt for missing user information or blocking findings with a resumable artifact and precise reason. Automated reviewers do not grant human approval: normal automated completion is an evidence-valid, reviewed-by-agents draft awaiting human publication readiness. Seed the first end-to-end golden eval on synthetic data, with recorded inputs, evidence constraints and versions.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Raw and clarified inputs produce an evidence-valid Finding or explicit needs-input/needs-attention result; no direct call between user-invoked skills.
- [ ] Method, Question and Reader concerns are preserved and blocking findings halt progression; an honest inconclusive outcome is accepted.
- [ ] The craft chain executes once at its intended stage and honors its three-pass bound; the run can resume after a missing approval/input is supplied.
- [ ] Model review is labeled separately from human approval; evals never forge approval to report completion.
- [ ] First golden eval asserts expected answer/abstention, definition version and permitted evidence, recording model, skill version, git SHA and result artifact.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Revisit reviewed Claims on new retained inputs (v0.1)
description: Deferred v0.1 runtime, outside the internal v0 completion closure. Refresh into new immutable input ids/revision, execute under each Claim's declared fixed/advancing window policy, evaluate versioned Recheck methods and the Question falsifier, and report holds/contradicted/insufficient-data/not-comparable without conflating them with execution failure. Preserve the original artifact and inputs; population/definition/method changes require an explicit comparability decision. Nonnumeric/manual policies remain not automatically evaluable. Show which Decision records cite each affected Claim in a small derived decision board, with fresh data coverage and limits; never infer that a decision is correct or automatically amend the owner's decision. Reuse completed capture, publication, Decision and review contracts rather than independently inventing them.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] New revision/input ids leave original replay/rerun intact; fixed-window restatement and advancing-window comparison are distinct tested paths.
- [ ] Threshold crossing and a large still-supporting improvement produce the correct proposition outcomes rather than old-value distance labels.
- [ ] Thin data, non-automatable policy, incompatible population/definition/method and execution failure remain distinct states.
- [ ] Decision board links exact Finding/Claim/Decision revisions and names the owner judgment required; no inferred decision verdict or automatic action.
- [ ] New output follows normal human publication approval, Reader-safe export and revision/supersession rules.

title: Validate Recheck policies and decision evidence references
description: Implement the ADR 0009 schema contract in the same canonical JSON Schema used by new/check/render. Each Claim has a tagged Recheck policy: proposition predicate/threshold/direction, method or versioned method reference, evidence, applicable tolerance units/baseline, minimum data/coverage and fixed-versus-advancing window policy; or not-automatically-evaluable with a reason. The Question falsifier references an executable Check with declared outcome semantics. Decision records reference the exact Finding revision and Claim ids plus their own revisit condition. Engine failures and business predicate outcomes are different types. No Revisit evaluator, scheduling or decision board ships in this bead. Exemplars establish the schema shape; this bead owns its implemented validation and targeted failures.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] check accepts numeric policies and explicit non-automatable policies in representative fixtures.
- [ ] Missing predicate/method/units where applicable, invalid thresholds, missing non-evaluable reason, and unresolved evidence or Check references fail with category and path.
- [ ] Decision references bind to an existing Finding revision and Claim ids; window policy remains on the Claim and schedules include an explicit timezone.
- [ ] Minimum-data/coverage and fixed/advancing-window fields validate; non-evaluable never defaults to true/false.
- [ ] A falsifier predicate result is representable separately from query execution failure; validation does not run the deferred comparison evaluator.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Onboard a team to a working, resumable private Instance
description: Implement idempotent /setup-aftergrid using the existing layouts and adapters. Collect only required configuration, scaffold private definitions/readers/findings/decision log/golden Questions, verify hard dependencies, install and exercise the hook, and validate the selected connection/capabilities without overwriting existing files or exposing credentials. DuckDB uses its read-only local-file policy; Postgres must satisfy its privilege/runtime requirements. Preflight publication with the GitHub authority: distinct PR automation identity and allowlisted human approver, trusted allowlist source and documented credential separation. Missing external approval/API/runtime capabilities leave a usable local draft/replay path with explicit unavailable publication/rerun status. Store secret references rather than credentials in committed profiles; preserve prior progress on rerun.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Fresh synthetic Instance reaches new/check/draft-render; rerun preserves user definitions, Reader profiles, hooks and existing Findings.
- [ ] Missing hard dependency or unsupported required capability has a precise install/configuration remedy and resumes cleanly after correction.
- [ ] Write-capable Postgres role is rejected; DuckDB unsupported role-probe is not confused with lack of a read-only file safety policy.
- [ ] Hook is actually installed and exercised before reporting readiness for unattended runs.
- [ ] Solo approval preflight detects author=reviewer mismatch or unavailable API without faking approval; sandbox smoke proves the supported identity split.
- [ ] Credentials never appear in generated tracked files, logs or example artifacts; setup smoke uses synthetic configuration and controlled API doubles.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: CLI scaffold, new Finding drafts, and contract validation
description: Implement the reviewed contract, not a second competing schema. Create the repository layout, TypeScript CLI, test harness and `aftergrid new finding <slug>`. New creates fresh identifiers and an explicitly incomplete draft without overwriting an existing Finding. `aftergrid check` separates syntactic/schema errors, incomplete content, evidence validity and publication readiness, returning stable machine-readable categories plus useful human explanations and locations. Initial fixtures drive schema/reference behavior; execution and publication gates are completed by their downstream beads. An untouched draft may be structurally valid but cannot claim a complete or reviewed analysis. Use a supported Node/platform matrix and packaged dependencies that install without a local compiler; this does not prohibit prebuilt native runtime packages.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Both completed exemplars pass implemented schema/reference checks; unresolved references, missing/duplicate row keys and invalid identifier grammar fail with precise locations and categories.
- [ ] new finding produces a syntactically valid incomplete draft with unique ids; a second invocation cannot overwrite existing artifacts.
- [ ] An incomplete draft reports missing content and publication not ready; no made-up evidence or approval is inserted to satisfy validation.
- [ ] Stable result-set id + row-key + column references resolve independently of row order; no expression evaluation in reference tokens.
- [ ] Seam-1 checks run in CI; CLI help states the supported runtime and draft/check/render lifecycle; local install needs no native compilation on the declared supported platforms.
- [ ] Artifact-verification and retained-input rerun modes report whether SQL was actually reexecuted; a saved artifact is never labeled freshly rechecked merely because its hashes match.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Deterministic learning and failure dataset with reference Questions
description: Generate a small synthetic consumer-app dataset for both engineering fixtures and model evaluation, using supported DuckDB runtime facilities. Users, events and subscriptions contain planted churn/funnel/mix effects plus deliberately labeled duplicates, zero denominators, late events, incomplete coverage and insufficient evidence. Produce three to five reference Questions with approved synthetic definitions, expected answers or abstention, tolerances and expected evidence constraints. Keep deterministic engine errors distinct from semantic situations an honest analysis must explain: population mix shift does not by itself require a mechanical Check failure. Nightly orchestration lives in its own bead. These fixtures should help explain why an answer is supported, not reward a model for repeating a predetermined recommendation.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] A seed recreates the same logical rows/results and input metadata; any byte-hash expectations define canonical storage/serialization rather than relying on incidental database bytes.
- [ ] Every planted failure has an expected engine category, analytical outcome or review concern, clearly distinguishing those layers.
- [ ] Reference Questions and definitions validate; at least one expects abstention and one tests denominator/baseline reasoning.
- [ ] Reference calculations are independently inspectable SQL/data examples with units, population, windows and tolerances; expected causal conclusions are not invented from associations.
- [ ] Fixtures contain no Spot Sports identifiers, schema or production data and run in bounded CI resources.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: Verify the internal v0 milestone and record remaining release gates
description: Finish the internal v0 milestone only after every retained v0 feature has implemented acceptance evidence. Verify the exact candidate revision with deterministic Finding/adapter suites, a green full golden evaluation, complete private automated readout, actual Reader smoke feedback, package/install smoke and truthful capability matrix. Check publication binding, setup/hook and asynchronous intake explicitly; parent-child membership alone is not sufficient dependency coverage. Record outstanding usability/operational limitations and the next external-release study. This task does not publish packages, flip repository visibility or claim external-release validation merely because a study is scheduled. Follow-on release readiness has its own bead; Revisit runtime remains v0.1.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] All v0 child feature tasks are in the milestone blocking-dependency closure and completed with their named evidence; deferred Revisit runtime is excluded.
- [ ] Deterministic seams and full golden suite pass at the exact recorded candidate SHA, with no stale green substituted.
- [ ] Private real Finding and Reader smoke show answer, denominator, baseline, limitation, action/inaction and follow-up understanding.
- [ ] Complete clean-install workflow, publication authority, hook and asynchronous intake acceptance evidence are linked.
- [ ] Capability matrix marks unsupported/unvalidated behavior honestly; known limits and external-release prerequisites are recorded.
- [ ] Internal milestone completion makes no repository visibility, npm publication or other public activation change.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.

title: v0: one Finding end to end
description: Deliver the owner-approved v0 through reviewed exemplars, one retained DuckDB Finding, evidence and publication validation, a manual private Reader pilot, the full craft/analysis skill chain, deterministic decisions, both adapters, setup/hook, background intake, distribution smoke and versioned evaluations. Sources: docs/spec/v0-one-finding-end-to-end.md, docs/design/v0-design-2026-09-15.md, CONTEXT.md, ADRs 0001–0009 and docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md. Beads are the development tracker; GitHub Issues remain the product Instance intake. Scope is preserved; Revisit runtime and external release readiness are separate follow-ons. Internal milestone completion does not authorize public activation.
design: Order: exemplars plus real Reader feedback -> skeleton -> DuckDB; renderer, Recheck validation and synthetic references -> evidence validation -> manual private Finding before skill work. Writer and question/analysis skills can then develop independently; iteration uses renderer plus publication binding; orchestrator consumes those tested contracts. Postgres and hook work can run after DuckDB; setup integrates both plus approval preflight. Intake requires setup and orchestrator. Decide has its own deterministic command ticket after evidence/schema. Automated real readout compares with the manual pilot, records a real decision and genuine approval. Distribution tests the complete install without publishing. Nightly evaluation is separate from fixture generation; the internal milestone requires every v0 feature transitively. External-release study/readiness and v0.1 Revisit depend on that milestone, not vice versa. Every bead names observable acceptance evidence; user studies require real people, never simulated completion.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Every retained v0 child feature is covered by the internal milestone dependency closure and passes named acceptance evidence.
- [ ] The exact candidate revision passes Finding/adapter seams and the full golden suite; required human Reader and owner-decision evidence is recorded privately.
- [ ] A complete locally packed install supports all promoted skills and v0 commands, including hook and intake, with honest capability/readiness status.
- [ ] Private production data never enters the Engine; external-release study and public activation remain explicit follow-on gates.
notes:
COMPLETED: design grilled, reviewed by CobaltSpring, reconciled; spec written (docs/spec) and mirrored to GitHub #1. IN PROGRESS: nothing. NEXT: /to-tickets against the spec -> child beads under this epic. KEY DECISIONS: internal dev tracking = beads (br); product Instance intake stays GitHub Issues (a feature, not our process).
All existing beads reviewed and revised in plan space. New dedicated decide and external-release-readiness beads preserve existing user requirements without bundling unrelated work. No implementation or public activation performed.

title: Record an owner decision against reviewed evidence
description: Implement aftergrid decide as a deterministic user action, separate from evidence lint and narrative revision. Validate owner-supplied action or deliberate inaction, rationale, date, exact Finding revision and Claim ids, revisit condition and optional outcome. Show the proposed record before confirmation or accept explicit complete CLI input; never infer approval or a decision from a merged Finding. Append durably with a stable record id, avoid duplicates on retry and preserve prior decisions when corrections create a new linked record. A missing outcome means pending, not zero impact. The Reader follow-up route reaches the Operator, who records the actual owner decision.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Valid explicit input creates one Decision record bound to existing Finding/Claim revisions; invalid/missing references or owner fields fail without a partial append.
- [ ] Action and deliberate inaction both work; rationale and revisit condition are preserved and unknown outcomes remain pending.
- [ ] Retry with the same request id produces no duplicate; a conflicting reuse or concurrent append is handled explicitly without losing records.
- [ ] Correction appends a linked superseding record, preserving the prior record; merge or render alone never creates a decision.
- [ ] CLI output shows what was recorded and where the owner can find it; test uses synthetic records and includes malformed dates/timezones.

title: Write Findings people can understand and inspect
description: Implement /write-finding and /shape-narrative under writing-for-agents, using lessons from the manual Reader pilot. Consume the shared Analysis-directory contract and produce fixed sections, typed Claims/Recheck policies, evidence references, chart specs and a valid manifest. Select the named Reader profile or clearly disclosed generic fallback. Put material caveats beside the Answer; require chart/table evidence only for numeric Claims. Questions requiring reframing and insufficient evidence are honest valid outcomes. The writer cannot fabricate definitions, approvals, evidence or a causal conclusion to satisfy the template. Use synthetic recorded runs as regression fixtures and named qualitative reviewer criteria; do not embed company nouns or personal Reader details in Engine skills.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Numeric and nonnumeric Analysis inputs produce evidence-valid Findings with zero manual structural/value corrections in the recorded acceptance run.
- [ ] Answer-first structure and Claim evidence lint pass; method/narrative criteria explicitly cover what lint cannot judge.
- [ ] A named Reader profile and missing-profile fallback are both exercised; denominator, baseline, window and decision-changing caveat remain understandable.
- [ ] All displayed analytical values bind to the input evidence, with no invented causal wording or approval status.
- [ ] Recorded synthetic runs preserve inputs, model/skill versions, outputs and reviewer outcome; private pilot observations are not committed.
notes: Plan-space review 2026-09-15 by CobaltSpring at Patrick's request. See docs/design/bead-plan-review-2026-09-15.md for per-bead rationale, authoritative ordering and release boundaries.
